title: cancel (runtime → connector)
description: Ask the connector to abort the in-flight request `id` before the runtime ends it. The v1 runtime sends it only while the worker shuts down (`drain`: drain grace running out; `stop`: scan cancelled or worker stopping); deadlines never produce a cancel. The connector cancels user code and ends the request with `error` type `cancelled` (or its normal reply), which the runtime records as ScantorError type `cancelled` (not retried, not an attempt). After cancelGraceMs the runtime kills the process group.
